name: @kiwa-test/cli-test
description: CLI / shell / file IO test adapter for kiwa (execFile + temp dir + stdout/stderr snapshot)

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --testTimeout 15000
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --testTimeout 15000 --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/index.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/setup-cli-env.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/expectations.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**'
